heading: THE $400,000 CHIEF OF STAFF IS THE CEO'S SECRET WEAPON IN THE AI AGE (5 MINUTE READ)
blurb: AI-era CEOs are increasingly hiring chiefs of staff as strategic partners, not just assistants. The role has grown as leaders face greater complexity, with chiefs of staff helping execute initiatives and build workflows. While AI may automate some administrative tasks, skills like judgment, communication, and influence remain difficult to replace. The position is also becoming a leadership pipeline, with many chiefs of staff moving into executive roles.
